title: Beyond Linear Decodability: Understanding and Improving Instruction Following in World Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27401v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World action models (WAMs) exhibit strong manipulation capabilities yet often fail to follow test-time language instructions. Prior work shows that non-following (NF) WAMs encode information about the instructed target, but this information does not control their behavior. By comparing NF WAM with its instruction-following (IF) counterpart, we find that target information is substantially more linearly decodable in IF WAMs, despite being encoded in both. Motivated by this observation, we introduce linear decodability supervision (LDS), a simple yet effective auxiliary training objective that promotes the linear decodability of the instructed target information. On LIBERO-CF, InternW0-$\Delta$ with LDS achieves a success rate of 74.6% and a grounding rate of 89.2%, surpassing the strongest baseline by 26.8 and 42.9 percentage points, respectively. translated_title: 超越线性可解码性：理解与改进世界动作模型中的指令遵循能力
translated_abstract: 世界动作模型（WAM）展现出强大的操作能力，但在测试时往往无法遵循语言指令。先前的研究表明，不遵循指令（NF）的世界动作模型虽然编码了有关指令目标的信息，但这些信息并不能控制其行为。通过将不遵循指令的WAM与其遵循指令（IF）的对应模型进行比较，我们发现尽管两者都编码了目标信息，但在遵循指令的WAM中，目标信息的线性可解码性显著更高。受这一观察启发，我们提出了线性可解码性监督（LDS），这是一种简单而有效的辅助训练目标，旨在促进指令目标信息的线性可解码性。在LIBERO-CF基准上，采用LDS的InternW0-Δ实现了74.6%的成功率和89.2%的定位率，分别超越最强基线26.8和42.9个百分点。LDS的有效性挑战了当前流行的解释，即编码的目标信息……
tldr: 本研究发现世界动作模型的指令遵循能力与目标信息的线性可解码性密切相关，并提出线性可解码性监督（LDS）这一简单有效的辅助训练目标，使模型在LIBERO-CF上的成功率和定位率分别大幅超越最强基线26.8和42.9个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that instruction following in world action models correlates with the linear decodability of instructed target information, and proposes Linear Decodability Supervision (LDS), a simple auxiliary training objective that boosts success and grounding rates on LIBERO-CF by 26.8 and 42.9 percentage points over the strongest baseline.
